description: Unit test for the ThingsSseRouteBuilder class, testing Server-Sent Events (SSE) routes related to 'things'. It verifies HTTP methods, request handling with headers and query parameters, and the SSE stream setup using Akka HTTP and Akka Streams.

classes.name: ThingsSseRouteBuilderTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying SSE route handling in ThingsSseRouteBuilder with various HTTP requests, headers, query parameters, and stream behavior.

methods.name: setUpClass
methods.description: Sets up the static ActorSystem and common headers before all tests.

methods.name: tearDownClass
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after all tests.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment, including creating test probes, a route builder, and configuring the route for each test.

methods.name: getWithoutAcceptHeaderFails
methods.description: Verifies that requests without 'Accept: text/event-stream' header fail with NOT_FOUND.

methods.name: putWithAcceptHeaderFails
methods.description: Ensures that PUT requests with 'Accept' header return METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED.

methods.name: postWithAcceptHeaderFails
methods.description: Ensures that POST requests with 'Accept' header return METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED.

methods.name: deleteWithAcceptHeaderFails
methods.description: Ensures that DELETE requests with 'Accept' header return METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED.

methods.name: getWithAcceptHeaderAndNoQueryParametersOpensSseConnection
methods.description: Tests that a GET request with correct header opens an SSE connection with expected streaming parameters.

methods.name: searchWithoutQueryParameters
methods.description: Tests search route with no query params; verifies response and that a StreamThings message was sent.

methods.name: searchWithQueryParameters
methods.description: Tests search route with filter, options, and namespaces; verifies correct parsing and message sending.

methods.name: searchWithResumption
methods.description: Tests resuming a stream with a Last-Event-ID header; verifies the stream resumes with the correct sort values.

methods.name: getWithAcceptHeaderAndFilterParameterOpensSseConnection
methods.description: Tests SSE connection with a filter query parameter.

methods.name: getWithAcceptHeaderAndNamespacesParameterOpensSseConnection
methods.description: Tests SSE connection with a 'namespaces' query parameter.

methods.name: executeThingsRouteTest
methods.description: Helper method that executes a test route, verifies headers, initiates stream, and handles expected failures.

methods.name: replySourceRef
methods.description: Replies a SourceRef to the provided TestProbe for testing purposes.
